aboutGame.title: What is Loop Dungeon Incremental?
paragraphs: Loop Dungeon Incremental is a single-player incremental RPG from Playsect, released on Steam for Windows on October 19, 2026. You recruit heroes with distinct roles, send a party into repeatable dungeon loops, and let automatic combat handle the fighting while you manage the roster, gear, and upgrade choices.

Every expedition produces loot and resources that feed permanent improvements. When clear speed stalls, a prestige reset trades current depth for lasting bonuses, so the next run can climb further. Our Loop Dungeon Incremental guides cover the first-hour plan, party roles, Mage builds, skill-tree priorities, item farming, boss preparation, and the 29 Steam achievements.

modules.description: Help new players understand the core gameplay loop, automatic combat, hero recruitment, and the first-hour upgrade choices that keep a run moving.

highlights.detail: Run the starting party through the dungeon without upgrades and note where it stalls.
Recruit a second hero before buying damage upgrades.
Fill the front line so damage is not funneled onto one hero.
Buy cheap permanent upgrades first because their bonuses never become dead weight.
Push until the party wipes twice on the same floor, then invest instead of resetting.
Bank loot until you can afford one meaningful tier upgrade rather than several small purchases.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Loop Dungeon Incremental.

items.question: What is Loop Dungeon Incremental?
items.answer: Loop Dungeon Incremental is a single-player incremental RPG from Playsect. You recruit heroes with different combat roles, send a party into automated dungeon loops, collect loot, and invest in permanent upgrades. It released on Windows PC through Steam on October 19, 2026.

items.question: Is there a free demo of Loop Dungeon Incremental?
items.answer: Yes. The official Steam store page for Loop Dungeon Incremental offers a free demo, so you can test the automatic combat, party building, loot loop, and upgrade pacing before buying the full game.

items.question: How does prestige work in Loop Dungeon Incremental?
items.answer: A Loop Dungeon Incremental prestige reset ends the current run and grants permanent bonuses for future expeditions. Reset when clear speed stalls and the next meaningful upgrade costs more than the prestige bonus can provide, then use the new multiplier to push past your previous best floor.

items.question: What party size works best in Loop Dungeon Incremental?
items.answer: A focused core of two or three well-invested heroes performs better than a wide bench of half-geared characters. Add a fourth hero when it supplies a specific effect the core lacks, such as Priest healing, Rogue burst, or an Activate-style trigger.

items.question: How do I fix the Loop Dungeon Incremental Windows 11 crash?
items.answer: The launch error reported for Loop Dungeon Incremental is Fatal error: Failed to load il2cpp, tied to Windows 11 Smart App Control. Check the pinned Steam news post, verify the game files through Steam, review whether Smart App Control is enabled, and post the error text with your system specifications in the Steam discussions thread.
